entities.summary: Philothée O'Neddy, born Théophile Auguste Marie Dondey de Santeny, was a French poet. He was an associate of the Romantic movement, and one of the original "Bohemians". He is known for his 1831 collection Feu et flamme. He also wrote fiction, such as Histoire d'un anneau enchanté (1842).

entities.summary: Philothée O'Neddy, born Théophile Auguste Marie Dondey de Santeny, was a French poet. He was an associate of the Romantic movement, and one of the original "Bohemians". He is known for his 1831 collection Feu et flamme. He also wrote fiction, such as Histoire d'un anneau enchanté (1842).
